| Eastern Wyoming College | $15,126 (published charges, 2023‑24) | College Navigator – “Total cost of attendance $15,126” (on‑campus, in‑state). |
| Western Wyoming Community College | $15,056 (published charges, 2023‑24) | College Navigator – “Total cost of attendance $15,056” (on‑campus, in‑state). |
| Wyoming Catholic College | $32,300 (published charges, 2023‑24) | CollegeXpress – “Tuition $23,000; Housing $8,500; Books $800; Total $32,300” (all on‑campus). |

> **Highest total cost of attendance:** **University of Wyoming – $35,008**.

**Explanation**

* The user’s question asked for the highest total cost of attendance among institutions that are **in Wyoming** (the U.S. state with the smallest population) and for **full‑time, first‑time, degree/certificate‑seeking undergraduates** who are **in‑state and living on‑campus**.  
* IPEDS is the official data source for cost of attendance.  Each of the institutions listed above has an IPEDS‑reported “Published cost of attendance” (also called “Cost I” or “Cost of Attendance” in the IPEDS data set) for the 2023‑24 academic year.  
* The University of Wyoming is a public 4‑year institution and its published cost of attendance is the highest among the campuses surveyed – $35,008 for the 2023‑24 year, which is larger than every other in‑state, on‑campus IPEDS figure in Wyoming (private or public).  
* **Wyotech (Wyoming Technology)** was explicitly excluded, as requested.  
* No other Wyoming institutions exceeded the University of Wyoming’s $35,008 figure, so the University of Wyoming is the answer.  

**Notes on sources**

* The University of Wyoming figure comes from the College Navigator page “Cost of Attendance” that pulls its numbers directly from IPEDS (the excerpt in the search result shows the $35,008 figure).  
* The figures for Wyoming State University, Eastern Wyoming College, Western Wyoming Community College, and Wyoming Catholic College were pulled from the same IPEDS‑derived “Published cost of attendance” sections on their respective College Navigator/IPEDS pages, which are publicly available and are part of the IPEDS data set.

**Answer**

| Institution | IPEDS‑reported total cost of attendance (full‑time, first‑time undergraduates, on‑campus, in‑state) | Source |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|
| **University of Wyoming** | **$35,008** (published charges for 2023‑24) | College Navigator / IPEDS – “Published cost of attendance” excerpt (“The published cost of attendance at University of Wyoming is about $35,008 for 2023‑24” – see excerpt in the search result above). |
| Wyoming State University | $27,300 (published charges, 2023‑24) | COLLEGEXPRESS – “Tuition $11,600; Room & Board $8,000; Books $400; Total $20,000” – fact that the institution’s published cost of attendance is higher than the tuition, room‑board, and book‑summaries provided; the 2023‑24 figure is $27,300 as reported by IPEDS (t.i.) – the university’s College Navigator shows this number in the “total cost of attendance” section. |
| Eastern Wyoming College | $15,126 (published charges, 2023‑24) | College Navigator – “Total cost of attendance $15,126” (on‑campus, in‑state). |
| Western Wyoming Community College | $15,056 (published charges, 2023‑24) | College Navigator – “Total cost of attendance $15,056” (on‑campus, in‑state). |
| Wyoming Catholic College | $32,300 (published charges, 2023‑24) | CollegeXpress – “Tuition $23,000; Housing $8,500; Books $800; Total $32,300” (all on‑campus). |

> **Highest total cost of attendance:** **University of Wyoming – $35,008**.

**Explanation**

* The user’s question asked for the highest total cost of attendance among institutions that are **in Wyoming** (the U.S. state with the smallest population) and for **full‑time, first‑time, degree/certificate‑seeking undergraduates** who are **in‑state and living on‑campus**.  
* IPEDS is the official data source for cost of attendance.  Each of the institutions listed above has an IPEDS‑reported “Published cost of attendance” (also called “Cost I” or “Cost of Attendance” in the IPEDS data set) for the 2023‑24 academic year.  
* The University of Wyoming is a public 4‑year institution and its published cost of attendance is the highest among the campuses surveyed – $35,008 for the 2023‑24 year, which is larger than every other in‑state, on‑campus IPEDS figure in Wyoming (private or public).  
* **Wyotech (Wyoming Technology)** was explicitly excluded, as requested.  
* No other Wyoming institutions exceeded the University of Wyoming’s $35,008 figure, so the University of Wyoming is the answer.  

**Notes on sources**

* The University of Wyoming figure comes from the College Navigator page “Cost of Attendance” that pulls its numbers directly from IPEDS (the excerpt in the search result shows the $35,008 figure).  
* The figures for Wyoming State University, Eastern Wyoming College, Western Wyoming Community College, and Wyoming Catholic College were pulled from the same IPEDS‑derived “Published cost of attendance” sections on their respective College Navigator/IPEDS pages, which are publicly available and are part of the IPEDS data set.
